name: Natsume An-An
source:
A recluse who struggles with communication. Certain circumstances have rendered her unable to speak, spending her days without uttering a word to anyone. She prefers to keep to herself, and stays indoors all day, playing games. She has a remarkably low standard for self-praise, praising herself for even the smallest of efforts such as brushing her teeth. She dislikes exerting any effort, and avoids pushing herself beyond what's necessary. She hardly ever speaks, and instead communicates through writing. On the rare occasion that she does communicate with others, she uses an exaggerated and magniloquent manner of speech, reminiscent to that of a grand writer.

Original Sin: Sleeping Beauty of Deceit.
Magic: ???

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/An-An_Natsume]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Extended profiles are from the [url=https://https://manosaba.com/]Official Site[/url].]
